text: Elena Rostova is a Principal Machine Learning Engineer with over 8 years of hands-on experience building distributed training infrastructure. Her core proficiencies include PyTorch, Ray, CUDA optimization, Triton, and LLM fine-tuning across Kubernetes GPU clusters.

Marcus Vance has spent the past 5 years architecting enterprise cloud backend microservices. He specializes in Go, Docker, PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, gRPC, and Google Cloud Platform, leading high-throughput payment reconciliation systems.

Dr. Aisha Patel holds a Ph.D. in Computational Linguistics and brings 6.5 years of industry experience in Conversational AI and Natural Language Processing. Skilled in LangChain, Python, Hugging Face Transformers, Vector Databases (Pinecone/Weaviate), and Prompt Evaluation.

David Kim is a Senior Frontend Engineer with 7 years of specialized expertise in reactive web architecture. He is proficient in TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and WebGL visualizations.

Priya Sundaram is an Associate DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer with 3 years of production monitoring and CI/CD automation experience. Her technical repertoire includes Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS, Prometheus, Grafana, and Bash scripting.
